decision_skill.name: stable_phase_template_selection
decision_skill.description: Prefer a robust phase-aligned template when repeated cycles show strong same-phase agreement and no sustained directional change in amplitude.
decision_skill.applicability: When forecasting periodic data with enough complete recent cycles to compare phase stability, neighboring-phase disagreement, and cycle amplitudes.
decision_skill.decision_rule: Select the phase-template candidate when equal-phase historical values are consistently more similar than neighboring-phase values and recent cycle amplitudes fluctuate around a stable level rather than trending persistently; retain robust aggregation to limit transient disruption effects.
decision_skill.failure_condition: Do not use when phase alignment is unstable, complete cycles are insufficient, amplitude or level is persistently changing, or a verified structural change makes historical phases unrepresentative.
